page.title: Help
page.subtitle: A short guide to SAMARTH AI for your role: what each area does and what you can use today.

everyone.title: For everyone
everyone.description: These parts are open to every signed-in role.

learner.title: For learners
learner.description: Understand your skills, close your gaps and keep learning.

trainer.title: For trainers
trainer.description: Prepare material and quizzes for your learners.

admin.title: For admins
admin.description: Look after the people and the records of your organisation.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Your starting page. It greets you by name and points to the areas planned for your role.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Updates about tasks you started, newest first. Mark them as read or dismiss them; the bell in the top bar shows how many are unread.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Update your personal details and your photo.

security.title: Security
security.body: Change your password and manage the security of your account.

sessions.title: Devices and sessions
sessions.body: See where you are signed in and sign out of devices you no longer use.

gaps.title: Skill gaps
gaps.body: Choose a role to compare against, see where your skills fall short and filter the gaps by domain.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.body: Learning suggested to close your biggest gaps.

quizzes.title: Quizzes
quizzes.body: Practice quizzes and tests with feedback on every answer.

tutor.title: AI tutor
tutor.body: Ask questions and get answers that point back to the source material.

labs.title: Virtual labs
labs.body: Hands-on labs for practising statistical methods.

content.title: Content library
content.body: Upload and organise the material your learners study.

generate.title: Generate quiz
generate.body: Draft quiz questions from your material with AI help.

review.title: Review questions
review.body: Check and edit every drafted question before learners see it.

trainerQuizzes.title: Quizzes and results
trainerQuizzes.body: Publish quizzes and read how your learners performed.

users.title: Users
users.body: Find accounts in your organisation and suspend or reactivate them. Platform admins can also change roles.

invites.title: Team invitations
invites.body: Invite trainers to your organisation (platform admins can also invite admins), then resend or revoke invitations that are still open.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: Browse the tamper-evident record of important actions and check that its chain is intact.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Competency and learning figures across your organisation.

departments.title: Departments
departments.body: Group people into departments and compare them.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.body: Review the organisations on the platform.

framework.title: Competency framework
framework.body: Maintain the competencies and their levels.

items.question: I forgot my password. What do I do?
items.answer: On the sign-in page choose Forgot password and enter your email address. If an account exists we send a reset link. The reply is always the same, so nobody can find out whether an email address is registered.

items.question: How do I change my password?
items.answer: Open Settings, then Security, and choose a new password.

items.question: My account is locked. When can I sign in again?
items.answer: After five wrong passwords in a row the account is locked for 15 minutes. Each further wrong attempt doubles the wait, up to 24 hours. Wait until the time is over, then sign in again.

items.question: Why was I signed out?
items.answer: You are signed out when your session ends or when you sign out of it from Devices and sessions. Sign in again to continue; you return to the page you were on.

items.question: How do trainers and admins get their accounts?
items.answer: Learners create their own account. Trainers and admins join by invitation: an admin invites trainers, and a platform admin invites trainers and admins. Platform admins are set up by the people who run the platform.

items.question: Some menu items say Coming soon. Why?
items.answer: Those areas are planned for a later stage. They will start working without any action from you, and this page will show them as Available.

items.question: How do I change the language or the theme?
items.answer: Use the language switch and the theme toggle in the top bar. On a phone, open the menu and find them at the bottom.
